subject: Can one politely tell ggplot2 to shut up?

messages.author: 23e9c489ea8b313a
messages.subject: Can one politely tell ggplot2 to shut up?
parts:
When using ggplot2 to construct figures there are times when it feels compelled to tell you about things like

## stat_bin: binwidth defaulted to range/30. Use 'binwidth = x' to adjust this.

and

## geom_smooth: method="auto" and size of largest group is >=1000, so using gam with formula: y ~ s(x, b

I'm sure there is a way to prevent these informational messages appearing in the text but I haven't managed to find it.  Could someone provide a pointer?

messages.author: 30b406a9189eeb25
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Can one politely tell ggplot2 to shut up?
